identity_assertions.rationale: Plates 34 and 35's captions call the inn Angie ran the Lake Tahoe Inn; the post and Jack Alexander's obituary (plate 37) call it the Tahoe Inn.

notes.note: Plate 35's advertisement puts the Lake Tahoe Inn at 4110 Lake Tahoe Blvd, South Lake Tahoe: the post's address for the Tahoe Inn.
